de.abas.jfop.base.event

Class EventHandler

  • Object
    • EventHandler
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    FOPRunnable

    public abstract class EventHandler
extends Object
implements FOPRunnable

    A skeleton class for handling events in an JFOP context. A concrete implementation of this class normally also implements de.abas.eks.jfop.remote.FOPRunnable.

    During the runFop-method of the concrete event handler the handleEvent() method may be called then the appropriate delegation method will be invoked.

    So a concrete implementation has to override the event handling methods of this class.

    See Also:
    FOPRunnable

        public int runFop(String[] arg)
